entries.category_description: Medical equipment, aids and other appliances normally intended to alleviate or treat disability, for the exclusive personal use of the disabled, including the repair of such goods
entries.code_description: Brassières, girdles, corsets, braces, suspenders, garters and similar articles and parts thereof, whether or not knitted or crocheted
entries.comment: •For tariff headings of goods intended for the service of persons with disabilities needs, the reduced rate applies only on toilet Lift, handicapped bathtubs (3922), on swimsuit mastectomy, mastectomy bra (6212, 6112, 6211)
